p: thee a wife: Meaning that the affliction would be so horrible in Jerusalem that a wife and children would only increase his sorrow.
Enter not into the house of: Signifying that the affliction would be so great that one would not have leisure to comfort another.
nor cut themselves: That is, should not tear their clothes in sign of mourning.
cup of consolation to drink for: For in these great extremities all consolation and comfort will be in vain.
our iniquity: Because the wicked are always rebellious and conceal their own sins and murmur against God's judgments, as though he had no just cause to punish them, he shows him what to answer.

from all the lands where he: Signifying that the blessing of their deliverance out of Babylon would be so great that it would abolish the remembrance of their deliverance from Egypt: but he has here chiefly respect to the spiritual deliverance under Christ.
fishermen: By the fishers and hunters are meant the Babylonians and Chaldeans who would destroy them in such sort, that if they escaped the one, the other would take them.
carcases of their detestable and abominable: That is, their sons and daughters, who they offered to Molech.
strength: He wonders at the great mercy of God in this deliverance which will not only extend to the Jews but also to the Gentiles.
lies: Our fathers were most vile idolaters therefore it comes only of God's mercy that he performs his promise and has not utterly cast us off.
cause them to know: They will once again feel my power and mercy for their deliverance that they may learn to worship me.
